objective: Move one verified job event at a time toward a useful state transition while suppressing stale repetition and requiring explicit approval for every outbound action.

automation_state.activation_rule: Keep both paused until one canonical state package passes a dry run and David approves one bounded cadence, source set, token ceiling, writeback target, and stop rule.

event_reconciliation.scope: Before reply-now, apply-today, or any outbound authorization, search the same company and role across current human threads, application-platform updates, sent mail, and drafts.
event_reconciliation.terminal_precedence: A newer verified rejection, withdrawal, filled-role notice, or closed application outranks an older invitation, alert, queue row, or draft.
event_reconciliation.draft_rule: A draft is proposed text only. It is not evidence that contact occurred, it cannot override a newer terminal event, and malformed or no-reply drafts must never be surfaced as send-ready.
event_reconciliation.current_evidence_requirement: The selected action must cite the newest decision-relevant source event and state why older contradictory events are superseded.

source_truth.transaction_store: One proposed local state package in the existing job-search workspace.
evidence_inputs: Google Drive resumes and profile evidence

stable_key.ambiguous_merge_behavior: Keep records separate and surface one evidence conflict.

material_fingerprint.unchanged_behavior: Do not resurface as net-new and do not create a duplicate queue or tracker row.

queue_rules.reply_now: Fresh human outreach, interview setup, scheduling request, or direct question.
queue_rules.wait: Application confirmation or automated receipt that requires no reply.
queue_rules.lead_review: Alert, digest, or public lead that requires fit and contact-history review.
queue_rules.apply_today: Verified current role with reconciled prior-contact state, score at least 12, complete packet, and pending approval.
queue_rules.save: Score 9 through 11 or missing one non-critical fact.
queue_rules.closed: Rejected, withdrawn, filled, duplicate, or explicitly declined.

freshness_windows.rule: A stale proposal may remain in history but cannot authorize an outbound action.

prior_action_rule: Before recommending or applying to any company, reconcile current account, application, contact, rejection, and assessment history. Unknown history blocks outbound authorization.

approval_boundary.approval_scope: Approval must identify the exact company or thread, role, proposed action, and evidence event.

stop_rules: Source required for an outbound action is stale or unavailable.

low_energy_floor: Complete one verified local state transition or prepare one approval-ready action card; zero new leads is an acceptable result.
rollout_gates: Schema, policy, and resume registry pass validation.
July 22 snapshot dry run produces no duplicate stable keys or unsafe authorized actions.
One current inbox or role event is re-read and normalized.
David approves the exact first outbound action, if any.
A single bounded automation proposal replaces duplicate scheduled scans.
Drive and Wisebase projections pass readback without becoming transaction stores.
